quote: Under § 5.4, Customer had **30 days** from receipt (August 3, 2026) to object, i.e., until **September 2, 2026**. The Amendment was signed on **September 21, 2026** – 19 days after the objection deadline expired. The recital confirms no objection was delivered. Under § 5.4: "Any price adjustment to which Customer does not object within the period stated in this Section 5.4 is **deemed accepted** by Customer..."
reason: Issue 5 of the memo ties Amendment Recital C (receipt on August 3, 2026) to the 30-day objection period in Supply Agreement § 5.4. It correctly calculates the September 2, 2026 deadline, notes that this date falls before the September 21, 2026 amendment, and concludes that the 14% increase is deemed accepted. The memo does not expressly say that nothing in the Amendment extends or waives the deadline. In substance it covers that point: it treats acceptance as settled, notes the Amendment only recites the increase, and suggests equitable arguments as the only possible relief.
